briefdescription.para: Strongly-Typed Coordinate Space Definitions and Transformations.

detaileddescription.para:
Single Source of Truth for reference frame transformations across:
GodotCamera Space: +X Camera Right (Display Right), +Y Up, -Z Forward into room towards user
GodotFace Space: +X User's Right Ear (Display Left), +Y Top of Head, -Z Forward out of face
GodotDisplayPx Space: 2D px: Origin Top-Left (0,0), +X Right, +Y Down
OpenCVCamera Space: +X Right (Display Right), +Y Down, +Z Away into scene
OpenCVFaceModel Space: +X User's Left Ear (Image Right), +Y Down towards Chin, +Z Back into skull
OpenVINOADASGaze Space: +X User's Right Ear (Display Left), +Y Up, +Z Forward towards camera
